company.description: The competitor's name. Required unless item is given.

item.description: In a fan-out agent: this branch's item. A list-prepare slot {i, item_key, label, query}, a list-prepare accepted entry {index, item: {name, domain, pricing_url?, changelog_url?, blog_url?}, item_key, query} (a for_each branch), or a plain {name, domain}. item_key is copied unchanged. null = empty slot.
In an accepted entry: the competitor record as given.

lookback_days.description: Window length in days, ending at now.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time. Never guessed.

our_positioning.description: Who we are, who we sell to and how we win. Used for relevance and the so-what lines. If absent or cut short, the skill reads a prior step that read our positioning document.

watch.description: Topics that always matter to us, e.g. 'per-seat pricing', 'AI agent features'.

max_changes.description: Most changes to report, high importance first.

previous_state.description: Optional: the previous run's state when bound directly, one entry {item_key, fingerprint, observed_at, data} or {entries: [...]}. Usually a prior state read step supplies it instead.
